summary: Probably John's 3rd cousin 4x removed; Civil War musician, 149th PA 'Bucktails', 1862-65.
bio: Andrew Croop (b. 1843) served as musician, Co. F, 149th PA ('Bucktails'), 22 Aug 1862 - 24 Jun 1865, 'to the close of the war'; later 15 years a school director. Bradsby names brothers Alvin and Simon as also serving.
